item.title: Pulse 1.0.5
item.description:
Pulse v1.0.5 (Build 105)

  • Docker Detection & Null Ports Decoding Fix: Fixed an issue where containers without exposed public ports (e.g. Supabase, internal networks) returning null port arrays caused Docker decoding failures and falsely triggered "Docker Not Detected".
  • Resilient Container Decoding: macOS client now gracefully decodes null/missing container metadata fields across all daemon versions.
  • Docker Error State & Retry: Added dedicated failure card with actionable retry action when container retrieval encounters network or decode issues.
  • Agent Auto-Update Release Binaries: Restored standalone linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 release binary assets on GitHub Releases for one-command updates.

item.title: Pulse 1.0.4
item.description:
Pulse v1.0.4 (Build 104)

  • Brute-Force & Port Scanning Defense: Sliding-window rate limiter on the agent that automatically blocks malicious IPs for 15 minutes after repeated failed authentication or pairing attempts.
  • Pairing Session Brute-Force Lockout: Immediate revocation and purge of pairing sessions after 5 invalid code attempts.
  • CSWSH & HTTP Security Headers: Strict Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking origin verification, plus hardened HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff).
  • Tamper-Resistant Action Audit Trail: Linux agent records all executed actions, scripts, and runbooks with timestamp, user identity, and status to an append-only audit log (audit.log).
  • File Permission Audit in Doctor: pulse doctor now verifies strict file permissions (0600) for credentials and TLS keys.
  • TOFU TLS Certificate Pinning: The macOS app pins server TLS certificate fingerprints on first connect and alerts immediately if a certificate changes or is intercepted.
  • Biometric Security Gate (Touch ID): Optional Touch ID / Apple Watch / Mac Password confirmation before running destructive actions (reboot, service restart, kill container).
  • Clipboard Token Auto-Clearing: Sensitive pairing tokens and credentials copied to the clipboard are automatically cleared after 60 seconds.

item.title: Pulse 1.0.3
item.description:
Pulse v1.0.3 (Build 103)

  • Add Server UI Redesign: Prominent Method pickers (Direct IP, Cloudflare Tunnel, Tailscale) and Mode pickers (Root vs. Non-Root) right on the primary screen. No more hidden multi-step wizard!
  • Inline 1-Line Setup: Instant copy button for 1-line setup command with dynamic helper badge and server connection fields all in one clean view.
  • Universal Non-Root Support: Standalone non-root options for Direct IP, Tailscale, and Cloudflare Tunnel.

item.title: Pulse 1.0.2
item.description:
Pulse v1.0.2 (Build 102)

  • Non-Root User Mode: Full standalone support for non-root VPS accounts and shared environments. Installs to ~/.local/bin and ~/.pulse without requiring sudo.
  • Cloudflare & Tailscale Non-Root: All 3 connection methods now provide dedicated one-line non-root scripts without requiring root or open ports.
  • Add Server UI Redesign: Clean horizontal layout with separate Method (Direct, Cloudflare, Tailscale) and Mode (Root vs. Non-Root) pickers.
  • User-Level Systemd & Crontab Fallback: Automatically deploys and manages daemon via systemctl --user with auto-linger or crontab @reboot persistence.
  • CLI Mode Auto-Detection: pulse restart, pulse stop/start, pulse logs, pulse update, and pulse uninstall seamlessly operate in both root and user modes.

item.title: Pulse 1.0.1
item.description:
Pulse v1.0.1

  • Unified Pulse CLI: All-in-one command line tool (pulse) on Linux nodes for status, pairing, Tailscale, Cloudflare tunnels, logs, and self-updates.
  • Clean & Minimal Terminal UX: Removed all heavy ASCII/box-drawing borders for ultra-clean, modern terminal readability.
  • Network Offline Auto-Reconnect: Real-time network monitor that detects Wi-Fi/Ethernet drops and reconnects servers automatically when online.
  • Live Log Streaming Enhancements: Connection-state aware WebSocket log streamer with automatic retry and idle indicators.
  • UI Polish: Compact update modal sizing, pinned search headers, and clean borderless action buttons.

item.title: Pulse 1.0.0
item.description:
Pulse v1.0.0 — Major Release

  • Live Log Viewer & Streaming (⌘L): Real-time WebSocket log streaming for Systemd services and Docker containers with regex search, pause, and auto-scroll.
  • Outbound Telegram Alerts: Direct Bot API push notifications to user IDs and ops channels with 1-click test alert and flapping protection.
  • Disk Space Analyzer (⌘U): Instant breakdown of disk usage across /var/log, Docker, cache, and safe 1-click cleaners (vacuum journals, docker prune, clean apt).
  • Maintenance Runbooks (⌘R): 1-click execution for reloading web servers (Nginx/Caddy), flushing DNS cache, checking OS updates, and dropping pagecache.
  • Process Network & Disk I/O: Real-time read/write KB/s throughput and open socket file descriptor audit in the Process table.
  • Menu Bar Live Metrics: Option to display CPU & RAM percentages directly in the macOS menu bar.
  • In-App Documentation (⌘/): Expanded guides for Telegram Bot setup, one-line installation scripts, and zero-trust private meshes.

item.title: Pulse 0.9.0
item.description:
Pulse v0.9.0

  • Server Tags & Environments: Group servers in the sidebar by Production, Staging, Development, and Other.
  • One-Command Automated Setup scripts for Direct IP, Tailscale, and Cloudflare Tunnel.
  • Support for all major Linux distributions (Debian, Ubuntu, RHEL, CentOS, Fedora, Arch, Alpine, openSUSE).
  • New XXX-XXX human-friendly pairing code format (e.g. 607-019).
  • In-app documentation window accessible via ⌘/ or toolbar.

item.title: Pulse 0.8.0
item.description:
Pulse v0.8.0

  • Security & Open Ports Inspector: Real-time socket audit, exposure detection, and UFW firewall checks.
  • Sparkle 2 Auto-Updater: Seamless native background and on-demand app updates.
  • macOS Launch at Login via SMAppService.
  • Custom URL Scheme deep linking (pulse://add) for 1-click server onboarding.
  • Pixel-perfect Apple HIG standard application icon.
